items.question: What does an engagement cost?
answer: The Rapid AI Opportunity Audit is a fixed PKR 3,000, delivered within 72 hours, and it is not credited against a later build. Larger work is quoted per scope, in writing, with the deliverables and exclusions stated before anything starts. Ongoing support, if you want it, is a monthly retainer with short notice — but most clients do not need one.
There is no tier system, no “from” pricing and no discovery fee that quietly becomes the first invoice.

items.question: How long does it take?
answer: One focused workflow is usually one to two weeks. A website is typically two to four. A multi-workflow systems engagement runs six to ten weeks and is usually phased. Research engagements take five to ten working days.
If you have a date you have not mentioned, say so at the start — the schedule is part of the scope, not something to discover in week three.

items.question: Who owns the work when you finish?
answer: You do, completely. Source code, documentation, runbooks, accounts and credentials all transfer at handover, along with a walkthrough of how to change things. There is no proprietary platform holding your business, and no dependency on us by design.
We would rather be re-hired for being good than kept hired for being difficult to leave.

items.question: Do you work with businesses outside Pakistan?
answer: Yes. Roughly half our work is with businesses outside Pakistan, delivered fully online — calls, shared documents, and work executed directly in your accounts so you keep control of everything. Timezone differences are handled by fixing a small set of agreed working hours, not by expecting instant replies.

items.question: What will you not do?
answer: We will not fabricate credibility — no invented testimonials, no fictitious clients, no inflated results. We will not sell software you do not need. We will not take a retainer for work that does not need one. And we will not take on a project where we are the wrong firm, which we will say plainly before you commit.
If a free tool solves the problem, we will tell you before you pay us.

items.question: What exactly do I get from the PKR 3,000 audit?
answer: An operational friction map of the workflows you described, a prioritised automation matrix scoring every candidate on impact, effort and confidence, an implementation roadmap with the tools we would use and the ROI we would expect, a 30-minute walkthrough, and a 15-minute call for your questions.
You get the raw working files, not just a summary. If anything in it is factually wrong about your business, we correct it within seven days at no charge.

items.question: What happens after handover?
answer: You get the documentation, the runbooks, the accounts and a walkthrough — and you are free to change things yourself afterwards. If you would rather we stayed close, ongoing support is a monthly retainer with a short notice period and a defined response window.
About half of our clients come back for a second phase within a year. The other half never need to, which is also a good outcome.

items.question: What if I want changes after it is delivered?
answer: Small refinements after handover are part of the handover week. Anything that changes the agreed scope is quoted separately and transparently — you decide whether it is worth doing, and we do not bill for discovering that it is not.
Every engagement states its revision window in the scope document before work starts.

items.question: Who can see my data and my accounts?
answer: Only the people working on your engagement, and only where the work requires it. Credentials are never shared in chat or email — we use a password manager and direct account access, and we remove ourselves when the engagement closes.
Anything that needs to run unattended is set up in your own accounts and your own infrastructure, not in a workspace we control.
